confidence_notes: Beer, coffee and the inexpensive meal are based on aggregated cost-of-living data from a web search: Numbeo figures via Expatica as of June 2026, checked against MyLifeElsewhere. The meal is about EUR 18.7, a domestic draught beer about EUR 3.4 and a cappuccino about EUR 2.1. I converted euros to US dollars at roughly 1.10, worked out from RBA cross rates on 18 Nov 2026. The search did not give a mid-range meal for two, a cocktail or a glass of wine, so these are model estimates. Wine is about EUR 3, using its usual low price relative to beer in Spain. The cocktail is about EUR 9, and the mid-range meal for two is about EUR 65, scaled up from the inexpensive meal. Accommodation figures are general-knowledge estimates for July high season and were not checked against listings. Bilbao is a business and tourism city with limited hostel supply, so the accommodation anchors are the least certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Bilbao's restaurant prices are about 15% above the Spanish average and a little below Madrid's. I set accommodation between San Sebastián (higher) and other mid-sized northern Spanish cities such as Santander and Oviedo (lower).
